sources.title: Data-Efficient Reinforcement Learning for Complex Nonlinear Systems
sources.snippet: This article proposes a data-efficient model-free reinforcement learning (RL) algorithm using Koopman operators for complex nonlinear systems. A high-dimensional data-driven optimal control of the nonlinear system is developed by lifting it into the linear system model. We use a data-driven model-based RL framework to derive an off-policy Bellman equation. Building upon this equation, we ...

sources.title: [2402.09668] How to Train Data-Efficient LLMs - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: The training of large language models (LLMs) is expensive. In this paper, we study data-efficient approaches for pre-training LLMs, i.e., techniques that aim to optimize the Pareto frontier of model quality and training resource/data consumption. sources.title: Data-to-Model Distillation: Data-Efficient Learning Framework
sources.snippet: In this paper, we propose a novel framework called Data-to-Model Distillation (D2M) to distill the real dataset's knowledge into the learnable parameters of a pre-trained generative model by aligning rich representations extracted from real and generated images.
